On Monday, asked about an NBC News report that Hegseth could consider a 2028 presidential run, Trump said it was too soon to discuss the possibility.
"I think he’s doing a fantastic job, but it’s very early to talk about that," Trump told reporters in the Oval Office.
He added, "We have to get through the midterms first."
Trump also called Hegseth "a very good guy" and suggested that several other Republicans could be considering a 2028 campaign.
"I’ll bet there’s ⁠a lot of people considering it that you don’t know about," Trump said.
He added, “Right now, all he loves is and all he cares about is the military and taking care of the military.”
